core: ER protein exit and quality control
qualifier: COPII export, ER retention and retrotranslocation
name: COPII export, ER retention and ER quality control
rationale: Members cover COPII cargo loading and ER exit, ER lumen retention and ERQC/ERAD retrotranslocation to cytosol, distinguishing it from confusables built on SRP targeting/folding or COPI retrograde traffic.

qualifier: G12/13-Rho and Rap1 effectors
name: Platelet GPCR agonist signalling via G12/13-Rho and Rap1
rationale: Members are platelet-activating GPCR pathways (ADP P2Y1/P2Y12, thromboxane, thrombin PAR, prostacyclin) and their G12/13-Rho and Rap1 effector arms, unlike confusables centred on GPVI/collagen adhesion, degranulation and integrin cytoskeletal signalling.

qualifier: ribonucleotide phosphorylation and pyrophosphate hydrolysis
name: Ribonucleotide phosphate interconversion and pyrophosphate hydrolysis
rationale: Members concern NMP/NDP kinase interconversion of ribonucleotides (ADP, GDP, GTP) plus hydrolysis of pyrophosphate and diadenosine polyphosphates, unlike confusables on creatine/mitochondrial ADP-ATP transport, inositol pyrophosphates or deoxyribonucleotide synthesis.

qualifier: oncogenic RAS/RAF/MEK mutants and negative feedback
name: Core RAS-RAF-MAPK cascade, oncogenic mutants and feedback inhibition
rationale: Members are the intracellular RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK (and ERK5/p38/atypical MAPK) cascade, its oncogenic RAS/RAF/MAP2K mutants and GAP/phosphatase feedback, whereas confusables centre on specific receptor tyrosine kinases (FGFR, ERBB, MET, KIT, FLT3) and their drug-resistant mutants.

qualifier: vasopressin receptors and aquaporins
name: Vasopressin- and aquaporin-mediated water homeostasis
rationale: Members concern vasopressin signalling (including AVP receptor defects in diabetes insipidus), aquaporin water transport and renal water reabsorption, unlike confusables on renin-angiotensin/sodium handling, osmotic stress responses or aquaglyceroporin glycerol/urea transport.

qualifier: mesenchymal, mechanoresponsive fibroblast programme and EMT
name: Integrin-matrix adhesion in mesenchymal cell migration and EMT
rationale: Members combine integrin/fibronectin/syndecan adhesion, focal adhesion and stress fibre assembly, fibroblast and endothelial migration with YAP/TAZ mesenchymal and EMT programmes, whereas confusables emphasise adhesion disassembly/invadopodia, bare ECM modules or Rho-ROCK/PAK and platelet cytoskeletal signalling.

qualifier: transition metal transport, detoxification and heme synthesis
name: Transition metal ion and heme homeostasis and detoxification
rationale: Members cover iron, zinc, copper, manganese and toxic metal transport, sensing and metallothionein detoxification together with heme synthesis/scavenging, oxygen transport and linked antioxidant (ascorbate, peroxide) processes, unlike confusables on erythrocyte gas/ammonium transport, NADPH redox or oxidative phosphorylation.

qualifier: lactate, fatty acid, carnitine and glucose transporters
name: Membrane transport of lactate, fatty acids, carnitine and glucose
rationale: Members are transporter processes and transporter-defect diseases for monocarboxylates (with basigin), fatty acids, carnitine and GLUT1 glucose, distinguishing them from confusables on pyruvate/creatine, organic anion/dicarboxylate transport or mitochondrial carnitine shuttle and beta-oxidation.

qualifier: mannose-phosphate and dolichol-phosphate-mannose donor synthesis
name: Glycosylation disorders of dolichol-phosphate-mannose donor synthesis
rationale: All members are CDG defects (PMM2, PGM1, MPI, DOLK, DPM1-3) or the synthesis step itself along the mannose-phosphate to dolichyl-phosphate-mannose donor route, unlike confusables on normal GDP-mannose metabolism or CDGs of later lipid-linked oligosaccharide and Golgi steps.

qualifier: Hox clusters, somitogenesis and neural crest/craniofacial derivatives
name: Hox-driven axial patterning, somitogenesis and neural crest craniofacial development
rationale: Members span Hox cluster activation, somite segmentation, neural plate border/neural crest and TFAP2 programmes and the craniofacial, inner-ear and pharyngeal organs they build, unlike confusables on joints, axial mesoderm/neural tube patterning or forebrain and cranial suture development.

qualifier: BH3-only activation through apoptosome and SMAC-IAP
name: Intrinsic apoptosis cascade from BH3-only proteins to apoptosome
rationale: Members trace the mitochondrial apoptosis pathway from BID/BIM/BAD/BMF activation and BAX/BAK oligomerisation to factor release, SMAC-IAP relief and apoptosome caspase activation, whereas confusables are limited to MOMP/cytochrome c regulation terms or NOXA/PUMA activation.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I transcription and rDNA chromatin control
name: RNA polymerase I rRNA synthesis and rDNA chromatin control
rationale: Members centre on RNA polymerase I initiation, elongation and termination at rDNA, its epigenetic control (NoRC, B-WICH, SIRT1, CSB/G9a), 5S rRNA and early pre-rRNA cleavage and MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis, unlike confusables on RNA polymerase II/III and HIV transcription, translation initiation or later ribosome assembly.

qualifier: increased contractile force and stress-induced hypertrophy
name: Cardiac contractile force enhancement and hypertrophic muscle adaptation
rationale: Members regulate heart contraction force, rate and relaxation together with stress-induced cardiomyocyte hypertrophy, sarcomere growth and fibre-type adaptation, unlike confusables centred on calcium handling and negative inotropy or on cardiomyocyte proliferation, regeneration and calcineurin signalling.

qualifier: Kv and Kir channels in phases 1 and 4
name: Cardiac Kv and Kir currents: resting potential, early repolarisation
rationale: Members are voltage-gated and classical inward-rectifier potassium channels and their roles in action potential phase 1 and phase 4 resting potential, unlike confusables covering depolarisation, plateau and late repolarisation phases, conduction, or two-pore, ATP-sensitive and calcium-activated potassium channels.

qualifier: bidirectional COPII export and COPI retrieval with vesicle tethering
name: Bidirectional COPII and COPI vesicle traffic between ER and Golgi
rationale: Members cover COPII cargo loading and ER-to-cis-Golgi vesicle targeting and tethering plus COPI budding and Golgi-to-ER retrieval, unlike confusables on ER targeting, insertion and quality control or on COPI anterograde and intra-Golgi traffic.

qualifier: modulation by betaglycan (TGFBR3), follistatin and negative feedback
name: TGF-beta/activin SMAD2/3 signalling modulated by betaglycan and antagonists
rationale: Members concern TGF-beta and activin signalling through SMAD2/3:SMAD4 and its tuning by TGFBR3, follistatin and receptor/SMAD downregulation, unlike confusables on cancer receptor/SMAD mutants, RUNX3 targets, AMH or BMP signalling.

qualifier: variants altering collagen/GPIb binding and ADAMTS13 cleavage
name: Von Willebrand factor variants altering adhesion and ADAMTS13 cleavage
rationale: All members are VWF or GP1BA variant defects affecting VWF binding to collagen or GPIb-IX-V and its ADAMTS13 cleavage, unlike confusables on fibrinolysis, contact activation, coagulation cascade or basement membrane collagen.

qualifier: linkage-specific DUBs restraining NF-kappaB and transcription factor activity
name: Linkage-specific deubiquitination restraining NF-kappaB and transcription factors
rationale: Members are deubiquitinase families and K11/K48/K63 deubiquitination with ubiquitin activation, plus negative regulation of NF-kappaB and transcription factor activity, unlike confusables on proteasome/neddylation, atypical chain synthesis or TNFR1-driven NF-kappaB activation.

qualifier: tubular network shaping and ER-organelle tethering
name: ER tubular network shaping and ER-organelle membrane tethering
rationale: Members concern ER tubule formation, membrane bending and fusion, ER positioning and ER tethering to plasma membrane, mitochondria (with Miro RHOT GTPases) and autophagosomes, unlike confusables on phosphoinositide synthesis and lipid transfer or microtubule organelle transport.

qualifier: saccule formation and type I/II pneumocyte differentiation
name: Lung saccule development and pneumocyte differentiation
rationale: All three members describe saccular-stage alveolar development and type I/II pneumocyte differentiation, unlike confusables on lung branching morphogenesis, mesenchyme, trachea or surfactant metabolism defects.

qualifier: p53 stabilisation, Cdc25A degradation and checkpoint recovery
name: Radiation-induced G2 checkpoint, p53 stabilisation and checkpoint recovery
rationale: Members cover the gamma-radiation G2 DNA damage checkpoint with p53 phosphorylation/degradation control, Cdc25A destruction and GTSE1/MASTL-mediated recovery into mitosis, unlike confusables on cyclin B G2/M events, p53 arrest/apoptosis target genes or ARF defects.

core: Germline and early embryonic genome programming
qualifier: piRNA transposon silencing, spermatogenesis and maternal-to-zygotic transition
name: Germline piRNA silencing, spermatogenesis and maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members span germ cell specification and spermatogenesis, piRNA biogenesis and transposon heterochromatin silencing, and zygotic chromatin remodelling, genome activation and maternal mRNA clearance, unlike confusables limited to maternal mRNA deadenylation/M-decay, imprinting or X inactivation.

qualifier: interferon-stimulated antiviral effectors (ISG15, OAS, PKR) and signalling feedback
name: Type I interferon-stimulated antiviral effectors and signalling feedback
rationale: Members are the downstream type I interferon response: IFN-alpha signalling and its negative regulation, ISG signatures and effectors such as ISG15, OAS and PKR, unlike confusables centred on upstream nucleic-acid sensing (RIG-I, TLR, cGAS-STING) and interferon production.

qualifier: UPR/eIF2-kinase signalling with NRF2 and FOXO transcription
name: ER and integrated stress response with NRF2 and FOXO transcription
rationale: Members cover ATF6/IRE1/PERK unfolded protein response, HRI/GCN2 translational control and mitochondrial UPR together with NRF2- and FOXO-driven stress transcription and stress-induced apoptosis, unlike confusables on mTORC1/p53 metabolism, ER targeting and folding, or HSF1 heat shock and chaperonins.

qualifier: SRP-dependent cotranslational and tail-anchored membrane insertion
name: SRP-dependent and tail-anchored protein targeting into ER membrane
rationale: Members are routes delivering proteins into the ER, SRP cotranslational targeting, post-translational translocation and tail-anchored or stop-transfer membrane insertion, unlike confusables on COPII/COPI export and ER quality control.
